decisions.reason: Product A remains close to the firm's formwork and engineering knowledge, and in-house R&D supports learning and improvement despite limited website visibility after 2018.
Product B builds on established automation and concrete distribution know-how, and the firm's absorptive capacity enables it to assimilate results and improve the product.
Product D closely aligns with existing magnetic formwork and engineering capabilities, and its product line with several models gives the firm sufficient related knowledge to learn and refine it.

Product E is a magnetic formwork component close to the firm's established offerings, and the firm's continuous R&D and cooperation with research institutions allow it to interpret early results and improve the product.
Product F is close to existing magnetic formwork knowledge but had weaker website presentation, so while the firm can still learn from it, the probability of withdrawal is slightly higher.
